scripts.build: npm run build -w @nahwi/web && rm -rf dist && cp -r apps/web/dist dist
scripts.test: npm test -w @nahwi/engine && npm test -w @nahwi/web && npm run validate -w @nahwi/content
scripts.check: npm test && npm run build && node scripts/check-site.mjs apps/web/dist && playwright test
scripts.check:payments: CHECKOUT=on PAYWALL=on REVENUECAT_IOS_KEY=appl_check npm run build && node scripts/check-payments.mjs
